findings.evidence: main.tex 第 185 行逐字：「the result of Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} explains why only these three directions can compete: for normals with a vanishing coordinate the area is an explicit decreasing function of $|a|^p+|b|^p$, so within that class the extremum is always at a coordinate vector or at the face diagonal, never in between.」而 thm:zero（main.tex 第 97–115 行；台账 stmt:000035）的前提是「at least one coordinate equal to 0」；三个坐标都非零的情形在本文里只有附录 A（行 218–224）的数值读数，正文第 4 节同一页自己也承认「the absence of a strictly interior maximizing direction is only verified numerically」（行 183）。同一节行 193 还把它列为 open problem (a)。
findings.message: 第 4 节把 Theorem thm:zero 说成「解释了为什么只有这三个方向能竞争」，但 thm:zero 只覆盖「至少一个坐标为 0」的法向，对三个坐标都非零的法向没有给出任何结论，这句话的强度超过它引的证据。

For normals whose three coordinates are all non-zero, the corresponding statement is at present only the numerical observation recorded above; Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} says nothing about that class.」原句「the result of Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} explains why only these three directions can compete」已不在正文里；同节 Limitations 段另写「the argument of Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} covers the normals with a vanishing coordinate, but no analytic argument is given for normals with three distinct non-zero coordinates」。强度已降到与 thm:zero（台账 stmt:000035，前提 at least one coordinate equal to 0）相称。此判为我逐句读本版正文所得。

findings.evidence: ① 正文 Theorem thm:delta(iii)（第 160–174 行，逐字）：「consequently there is $P_0\in[1,\infty)$ such that $A_{\mathrm{face}}(p)>A_{\mathrm{diag}}(p)$ for every $p\ge P_0$.」——只断言存在 P_0，没有任何一句把 P_0 钉到 p_* 上，也没有 Δ 在 (2,p_*) 内为负的结论。② 同节「Three features deserve comment」第一点（第 186 行起，逐字）：「Theorem~\ref{thm:delta} guarantees only that $\Delta$ is positive for large $p$, and locating the zero requires information about $\Delta$ on the whole interval.」③ 第 4 节「Numerically supported strong conjecture (not proved here)」段自述 p_* = 4.998215596862 是「(numerically), the unique solution of A_diag(p)=A_face(p)」，即 p_* 的位置是数值结论。三处互相对照：把「存在 P_0」写成「从 p_* 起占优」超出 thm:delta 能支撑的强度，与 round 1 finding 000000 同一类（该条当时判为 overclaim 并改弱）。④ 此判为我逐句读本版正文所得，不涉及数值对错。
findings.message: 第 4 节 Relation with the literature 把 thm:delta 说成「已证明从 p_* 起面对角向占优」，但 thm:delta(iii) 只给出「存在 P_0 使 p≥P_0 时 Δ>0」，未界定 P_0、也未证明 Δ 在 (2,p_*) 上的符号；同节第一点自己写着 thm:delta 只保证 Δ 在 p 大时为正，定出零点需要整个区间上的信息。

findings.message: 第 4 节 Relation with the literature 仍把 thm:delta 说成「已证从 p_* 起面对角向占优」，而 thm:delta(iii) 只给出「存在 P_0 使 p≥P_0 时 Δ>0」；同节第 187 行又自述 thm:delta 只保证大 p 时为正、定出零点需要整个区间上的信息 —— 正文自相矛盾，结论强度超出定理能支撑的范围。
findings.resolution_note: [manual] 手工判词：H 自己读出来的发现（record_finding 落库） [H 复核] [round 12] H 显式复核 ⇒ fixed：本趟 fs.read 只读现行正文 out/package/main.tex（读数 sha256=a4174b2f0733b7fac2698c4b88ce9d01f204ab5d88d98ec1ecdb328b26dca365、32529 B、231 行）第 189 行逐字：「and Theorem~\ref{thm:delta}(iii) shows that $A_{\mathrm{face}}(p)>A_{\mathrm{diag}}(p)$ for all sufficiently large $p$; numerically the crossover is at $p_*\approx4.998216$, which is evidence rather than a proved threshold.」原句「shows that the cube behaviour already dominates from $p_*$ on.」已不在正文里。现句把定理能撑的结论限在「for all sufficiently large $p$」，并把 p_* 明写成「numerically … evidence rather than a proved threshold」，与 thm:delta(iii) 的「there is $P_0\in[1,\infty)$ such that … for every $p\ge P_0$」（本趟 verify_fixes 读数抄回的 thm:delta(iii) 原文）相称；同节第 187 行逐字「Theorem~\ref{thm:delta} guarantees only that $\Delta$ is positive for large $p$, and locating the zero requires information about $\Delta$ on the whole interval.」与本句不再矛盾。另：references 键与 \cite 未动（\cite{ambrus}），本轮只判这一处措辞。
findings.suggestion: 把第 189 行该句改弱为「Theorem~\ref{thm:delta} shows only that the cube behaviour wins for all sufficiently large $p$; the crossing with the body-diagonal regime is located numerically at $p_*$ (Section~4, Appendix~A)」—— 一句话的改弱，与同节第 187 行的自述一致，不需要新增证据；改完由 G 重编 PDF 后再由 H 复审签现行 sha。
findings.verbatim_quote: Theorem~\ref{thm:delta} shows that the cube behaviour already dominates from $p_*$ on.
